Retrospective experiment, not a live forecast or absolute accuracy result. Both fitted cohorts use the same fitting length and optimizer and are tested at identical later epochs. Past source availability is unproven. Standard GP is included only if its snapshot was received before the retrospective origin. Missing baselines remain blank.

EXPERIMENTAL / NAVIC-BROADCAST-FIT

Broadcast-derived SGP4 models

New SGP4 mean elements fitted to broadcast positions. Later epochs are held out from fitting. These independent products reproduce the broadcast trajectory; they are not CelesTrak SupGP or an absolute accuracy assessment.

SatelliteOrbitFit RMS kmHeld-out RMS kmHeld-out max kmExport gate

Acceptance gates are provisional. A smaller fitting residual does not guarantee better later prediction. Click a satellite row for rejection reasons, coverage, thresholds and optimizer diagnostics.

REPRODUCIBLE BY DESIGN

One timeline. Explicit assumptions.

Both propagators evaluate the same physical instants. Residuals are GP minus broadcast, with invalid source epochs excluded from statistics.

01 / TIME & FRAME

IRN → UTC · TEME → ITRS

Pinned leap seconds, UT1−UTC and polar motion. Inertial RTN axes remain well-defined for GEO.

02 / VALIDITY

Gaps stay gaps

Nearest valid toe, health and IODEC checks. Signed GP age accompanies every paired epoch.

03 / INTERPRETATION

Provisional thresholds

Separate GEO and inclined GSO limits. Review the GPS/SP3 evidence in Data quality; thresholds still require calibration.
